summary.headline: Fortune in Beasts and Cattle
summary.text: Chapter XXIII explains judging a native’s fortune in beasts and cattle through the twelfth sign, its lord, Mars, planetary condition, and placement in the circle. It also concludes the preceding discussion of servants, considering the sixth place, its lord, the part of servants, Mercury, the ascendant lord, and converging testimonies of concord or impediment.
